how.title: How MYCORE12 Works
how.lede: Choose the response that best reflects how you have actually been lately. You can leave and resume later in the same browser.

steps.title: Read the situation
steps.body: You will see one everyday situation at a time, drawn from personal life, work and study, relationships, group activities, change, and decision-making.

steps.title: Choose what feels more natural
steps.body: Rate which of two positive responses is closer to how you would usually respond. There are no better or worse choices.

steps.title: See your 12-energy profile
steps.body: Review the balance across six energy pairs, your overall combination, and ways to use your strengths more broadly.

how.principle: MYCORE12 looks at how naturally you tend to use 12 positive energies across six paired preference axes. The two energies on each axis always add up to 100. The result describes relative preference, not total ability or rank.

privacy.title: Privacy & Local Storage
privacy.p1: You can use MYCORE12 without creating an account. Your assessment progress and results are stored only in this browser's local storage and are not sent to a server.
privacy.p2: Stored data includes your active assessment session, recently shown question IDs, and completed results. Your answers are not placed in a shareable URL.
privacy.p3: Select Delete My Results at the bottom of the page to remove all MYCORE12 data stored on this device. Results are not shared across devices or browsers.
privacy.p4: If Google AdSense advertising is enabled in the future, Google and other third-party advertising services may use cookies or similar technologies, along with browser and device information, to serve and measure ads.
privacy.p5: Even then, your MYCORE12 assessment responses and results are not provided as ad targeting information.
privacy.p6: You can manage advertising consent and settings through Google's consent messages, your browser settings, and Google Ad Settings below.

energyMap.title: MYCORE12 12-Energy Map
energyMap.description: The outer 12-sided frame is fixed for everyone. Each marker shows the relative preference score for one energy. Shape area is not used for interpretation.
energyMap.baseline: The dotted circle marks the 50-point reference line. Select a point to view its value.
